integrity: The proof is self-contained and its integer-arithmetic code checks all n=2,...,8, without claiming that a finite census proves the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only spanning-tree incidence vectors of K_{2,n} for integers n>=2. It does not extend to arbitrary matroids. Earlier equivalent signed-tree formulas could be unindexed; independent validation not performed.
title: Complete Walsh spectrum and sharp Fourier projection norms for the spanning trees of \(K_{2,n}\)
